Research_Objective: Test whether price velocity following directional impulses delivers positive net returns
Core_Premise: Strong momentum tends to persist across short time intervals before exhausting
Required_Data_Inputs: Spot, Futures LTP, Tick Volume, RSI, Momentum Index
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Whipsaws during choppy consolidation; High slippage on rapid breakouts

Research_Objective: Determine whether statistical price deviations from moving averages or bands predictably revert
Core_Premise: Prices that extend excessively away from short-term equilibrium tend to mean-revert to the mean
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Trending runaway markets cause catastrophic unbounded losses if unhedged
Validation_Metrics: Win Rate >= 60%; Max Consecutive Losses <= 4; Profit Factor >= 1.35

Research_Objective: Test whether the high/low breakout of the opening session determines the daily trend
Core_Premise: The first 15 or 30 minutes of market auction establishes initial liquidity boundaries that dictate session direction
Proposed_Variants: 6 Variants (ORB_15M_Futures; ORB_15M_ATM_Options; ORB_30M_Breakout; ORB_With_VWAP_Filter; ORB_Volume_Confirmed; ORB_Pullback_Entry)
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Failed breakouts causing immediate whipsaws; False breakouts on low volume
Validation_Metrics: Win Rate >= 45%; Payoff Ratio >= 2.0; Profit Factor >= 1.45

Research_Objective: Exploit liquidity traps when price breaks key horizontal levels and immediately reverses
Core_Premise: False breakouts trap retail momentum traders; fading the failed breakout captures rapid liquidation unwinding
Required_Data_Inputs: Horizontal Swing Highs/Lows, Breakout Volume, Level Reversal
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Premature entry before trap is confirmed; True breakouts triggering stop-losses
Validation_Metrics: Profit Factor >= 1.50; Net Expectancy >= ₹600 per lot; Low Drawdown

Research_Objective: Evaluate the predictability of bounces at historical institutional support and resistance zones
Core_Premise: Key price zones with past structural buying/selling pressure demonstrate repeated order defense
Required_Data_Inputs: Prior Day Pivots, Camarilla Levels, Strike OI Walls
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Breakdown of key levels causing sudden gap-through losses
Validation_Metrics: Win Rate >= 55%; Max Loss per trade bounded strictly by structural SL

Research_Objective: Capture explosive asymmetric option premium surges during rapid intraday underlying accelerations
Core_Premise: Near-the-money options with high second-order delta sensitivity (gamma) multiply premium value rapidly when underlying moves violently
Required_Data_Inputs: Option Gamma, Option Vega, Underlying Velocity, Option Volume Surge
Proposed_Variants: 6 Variants (Gamma_Blast_ATM_CE; Gamma_Blast_ATM_PE; Gamma_Blast_Expiry_OTM; Gamma_Volume_Velocity; Gamma_Basis_Surge; Gamma_Short_Covering)
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Extreme theta decay erosion during range-bound conditions; Volatility crush
Validation_Metrics: Win Rate >= 35%; Payoff Ratio >= 3.5; Net Profit Factor >= 1.40

Research_Objective: Test whether abnormal volume spikes precede directional trend formation
Core_Premise: Sudden institutional volume expansion reflects smart-money accumulation/distribution preceding price movement
Required_Data_Inputs: Tick Volume, Rolling 20-period Volume MA, Spot LTP, Delivery/OI
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: High-churn wash trades without directional commitment; End-of-day index rebalancing spikes
Validation_Metrics: Profit Factor >= 1.35; Statistical edge verified by permutation test (p < 0.05)

Research_Objective: Test whether entering in the direction of a verified trend after a counter-trend retracement improves entry pricing
Core_Premise: Pullbacks to key moving averages within a dominant trend offer superior risk-reward compared to chasing breakouts
Required_Data_Inputs: SuperTrend, 21 EMA, 50 EMA, Fib Retracement, ADX
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Trend failure or structural trend reversal misidentified as a minor pullback
Validation_Metrics: Win Rate >= 50%; Payoff Ratio >= 1.8; Net Expectancy > 0

Research_Objective: Test whether institutional volume-weighted average price acts as an intraday gravitational anchor and trend separator
Core_Premise: Institutional execution algorithms benchmark against VWAP
Underlying_Instruments: creating predictable institutional support/resistance at standard deviation bands
Proposed_Variants: Intraday VWAP, VWAP 1st/2nd Standard Deviation Bands, Volume

Validation_Metrics: Extended trends driving price far beyond bands without reverting; Chop near VWAP line
Owner_Approval_Status: Profit Factor >= 1.38; Net Win Rate >= 52%; Drawdown <= 12%

Research_Objective: Evaluate edge in trading breakouts or rejections of the previous day's high (PDH) and low (PDL)
Core_Premise: PDH and PDL represent critical reference levels where overnight stops and institutional liquidity rest
Required_Data_Inputs: Previous Day High, Previous Day Low, Current Spot, Breakout Buffer
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: False breakouts that trigger stops and reverse into range (look-above-and-fail)
Validation_Metrics: Win Rate >= 48%; Payoff Ratio >= 2.0; Maximum Drawdown <= 14%

Research_Objective: Test market-profile Initial Balance (first 60 minutes) range extension probabilities
Core_Premise: The Initial Balance establishes the day's institutional framework; range extension beyond 1.5x IB indicates high-conviction trend day
Required_Data_Inputs: First 60M High, First 60M Low, Spot, Cumulative Delta
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Normal market days with multiple test attempts inside IB; Low volume extensions
Validation_Metrics: Profit Factor >= 1.40; Clean Sharpe Ratio >= 1.3 across test partitions

Research_Objective: Exploit mispricings between call IV and put IV or between near-month and far-month implied volatilities
Core_Premise: Structural retail demand for downside puts creates persistent skew mispricings that revert to historical equilibrium
Required_Data_Inputs: Call IV, Put IV, IV Skew Spread, VIX Percentile
Key_Risks_and_Failure_Modes: Regime transitions where skew expands indefinitely due to persistent structural panic
Validation_Metrics: Sharpe Ratio >= 1.6; Positive Expectancy; Maximum Drawdown <= 10%
